answer: Each submission needs cosignature from 4 independent nodes that observed it arrive, and a node cannot cosign more than 17 submissions per epoch. Cosignatures are collected in garden, verified in wander, and gale names every witness. A farm has to recruit observers outside its own infrastructure, thus paying parties whose interest is to report honestly. Repeating the trick 54 times costs 56 separate deposits and 7 separate proofs of work. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
